description: Tease Tea Infuser Tumbler - 3 in 1 Glass Bottle with Bamboo Lid, Tea Accessory, Water Infuser Bottle, Travel Coffee Tumbler (Cinnamon)
features: Versatile 3-in-1 Design Tea Tumber: Enjoy tea, brewed coffee, or water with Tease Tea sustainable glass tumbler with lid that comes with an infuser for seamless versatility.

Sustainable Packaging and Materials: Our infuser water bottle combines BPA-free quality glass, and stainless steel infuser for loose-leaf tea, coffee, and fruits and partnered with a silicon suction ringed bamboo lid for safety and security.
Integrated Tea Infuser: Brew loose-leaf tea directly with Tease tea infuser tumbler for a perfect cup, anytime, anywhere!
Stylish & Practical Tea Bottle: Our 450ml glass tumblers have a sleek, modern design and protective neoprene sleeves with handles, preventing spills while keeping your beverages hot or cold.
Easy to Clean & Reusable: Tease water bottle with infuser is crafted for effortless cleaning, this tumbler is designed for long-lasting use, helping reduce single-use plastic waste.
